notes.title: 🤠 Hogtie Rides into Steam's Sokoban Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy, puzzle wranglers! [/h3]

We're thrilled to announce that Hogtie is joining the lineup for Steam's Sokoban Fest, running until April 28th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/147818779b627b3d0c02b6589898e492dcf2eb8e.png[/img]
Our demo has been recently updated and is available for download and play as we speak 🎮

Here are the changes we've mentioned before:
[i][list]
[*] You can now unlock cosmetics and customize your look. Want to run puzzles in a top hat and boots? Go wild!

[*] We’ve also balanced a bunch of levels and added brand-new ones, so whether you're just starting out or already lasso-deep, there’s something fresh to test your puzzle skills. 🧪🧩

[*] Our tutorials now feature video explanations, making it easier than ever to pick up the ropes (literally). 🤠📚

[*] And of course - bug fixes and quality-of-life updates to make everything smoother than a buttered-up bread loaf. 🥐🐛
[/list]
[/i]
Hope you all enjoy the lovely Sokoban Fest!

🐖 Pigs out! 🐷

notes.title: Hogtie Demo - NextFest October 2024 Update!
notes.content:
Hey cowboys! 🤠

We are happy to announce that [b]Hogtie[/b] is joining [b]NextFest October 2024![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/42f4c8720d022f9079212894b336079da7063973.jpg[/img]
Hogtie Demo will also be updated alongside, with a brand new biome and a bunch of new levels, try them out! 

Here is a list of changes we did for the new demo:

[list]
[*] [b]Added the Winter Biome:[/b] Play in this new world, filled with new puzzles and mechanics!

[*] [b]New Desert Biome Levels:[/b] Added new levels and updated old ones 

[*][b] Desert tiles:[/b] Desert biome should have different colored tiles now

[*] [b]Environment update:[/b] Added cool new stuff around the maps
[/list]

Enjoy the demo update and make sure to let us know how you feel about the new biome! Your feedback is extremely important to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/7a760cc05f57dc81838aeec087c6c185ab5691f4.png[/img]

[b]Also[/b], if you want to have a sneakpeek at our next biome, you might wanna play the last level of the Winter biome!

Pigs out! 🐷

notes.title: We’re Joining the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration! 🎉
notes.content:
Howdy, Hogtie fans!

We’ve got some thrilling news to share! [b]Hogtie[/b] has been accepted to join the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration, and we’re over the mud pit about it! 🐷🌟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/c953ba8d856ffe2c02c643cc0b7cae1ae15ad0fb.png[/img]

[h2]DEMO RELEASE[/h2]

But wait, there’s more! We’re also launching our [b]Hogtie demo[/b] on August 15th! That’s right—mark your calendars and prepare for a puzzle extravaganza.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

[list]
[*] [b]Explore our charming Sokoban-style puzzle game[/b] with the demo available on the same day as the celebration (August 15th in case you already forgot).
[*] [b]Dive into over 25 puzzles[/b] and experience the warm and… muddy? vibes of [b]Hogtie[/b].
[/list]

Join us in celebrating the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration and get a sneak peek at what [b]Hogtie[/b] has to offer!

Thanks for being part of our journey. See you on August 15th!

🐷👉[url=https://discord.gg/uyFkMzrKq8]Join our discord for news and updates![/url]👈🐷

notes.title: 🐷What We're Hog-Tying Up🤠
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/cb1b5905f553e1eb2e28c92b921bb6a80f12a141.png[/img]
[b]Howdy, Hogtie fans![/b]

We've been busier than a pig in a mud pit, and we've got some squealin' good updates for you!

[h1]What's Cookin' in the Alacrity Kitchen:[/h1]
[h2]Demo Coming Soon! 🕹️[/h2]

We're finishing up the final touches on the demo, and y'all can expect it to hit Steam at the VERY LATEST by the end of August. Cross your hooves, it's almost here!

[h2]Fine-Tuning the Fun:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]UI: [/b]Polishing it up like a shiny new horseshoe. 
[*] [b]Gamepad Integration: [/b]Making sure your controllers work smoother than a greased piglet. 
[*] [b]Playtesting Levels:[/b] Ensuring our puzzles are tricky enough to make your brain do a happy jig. 
[*] [b]Bug Fixes: [/b]Squashing bugs.
[/list]
 
We're in the final stretch, folks, and our tiny team is giving it all we got. Thank you for being patient with us through this wild ride. Your support means the world to us!

[i][u]So, don’t just sit there, join our Discord to stay updated and be part of the fun![/u][/i]
